claim.statement: Current Cascade documentation describes Search, Analyze, Web and configured MCP tools, terminal use, and package installation after the user presses Accept; it also documents a per-prompt tool-call limit and a configurable auto-continue path.

source.title: Cascade
source.locator: Tools; terminal; package installation; tool-call limit; auto-continue

limitations: Documented tools are availability claims, not evidence that any tool, network route, package install or MCP server was enabled or used.
unknowns: Enabled tools, MCP servers, credentials, terminal commands, network access, package-install decisions and auto-continue setting are unknown.
